title: factory.config.yml
description: Everything a consumer repo sets for the software factory. The factory holds no value that belongs to one repo.

spec_source.description: Which spec-source adapter reads and updates changes, for example openspec. Any adapter name is allowed here: whether the adapter is installed is checked by doctor, not by this schema.

owner.description: GitHub login of the one person who merges, is mentioned on escalation, and whose labels start work.

default_branch.description: The branch factory PRs target and the git hooks protect.

branch_prefix.description: Prefix of the branch a factory task is built on; the change id and task number follow it.

gates.description: Commands the agent must run before it pushes. An entry with no when runs always; an entry with when runs only if the change touches a matching path.

protected_paths.description: Paths the factory must never edit, added to the built-in baseline. The baseline cannot be removed from here.

forbidden_commands.description: Command prefixes the agent may not run, added to the factory's built-in denials.

review_bots.description: Logins of the review bots, without the [bot] suffix. A bot the factory has a profile for gets that profile; any other is treated as a plain review author.

reviews_timeout_minutes.description: How long after the last push factory/reviews-settled waits for a configured bot before it turns to success.

ci_workflows.description: Names of the CI workflows a babysit pass waits for. init writes the same list into the relay workflow's trigger, and doctor fails when the two differ.

runner.description: How the runner prepares a checkout before the agent starts.

node_version.description: Node version the factory's own scripts run on.

install.description: Command that installs the project's dependencies. A command, so other stacks can set their own.

spend_cap_usd.description: Per-run cost cap passed to the agent. Spend can pass it, so leave headroom.

timeout_minutes.description: Step timeout for one agent run.

max_babysit_rounds.description: Fix rounds a babysit pass may push for one PR (or one task of a per-change PR) before it stops and asks the owner.

change_id_max_length.description: Longest change id accepted. GitHub caps a label at 50 characters and the factory label is factory:<id>, so 42 is the most any value can be.

labels.description: Override a factory label name. The factory/no-go-guard status name is fixed and not set here.

chain.description: Hook scripts the installer runs after the factory's own main-branch check, for example a secret scan the project keeps.
